name: Specific Product Slider for WooCommerce
author: samiur6688

sections.description:
Specific Product Slider for WooCommerce is a flexible Gutenberg block that allows you to create product sliders by selecting specific WooCommerce products.

Perfect for landing pages, homepages, or custom marketing sections — this block gives you full control over which products to display and how they appear.

Features:
– Select individual WooCommerce products for each slider block.
– Display multiple sliders across different pages or posts.
– Fully responsive layout.
– Optional autoplay feature.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/specific-product-slider-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugin screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open any post or page using the block editor, and insert the Specific Product Slider block.
  4. Use the product picker to select WooCommerce products for the slider.
sections.faq:
Is there an autoplay option available?

Yes. You can enable or disable autoplay individually for each slider block in the block settings.

Can I create multiple sliders with different products?

Yes. Each block instance stores its own selection of products, so you can insert as many sliders as needed.

How many products are shown per slide?

One product is displayed per slide.
